settings.best_for: Global Care's 500 lb bariatric stacking armchair for exam rooms, patient areas, and waiting rooms — a compact footprint, wall-saver legs, and flat polypropylene armrests that assist entry and exit. Stacks two-high for storage.

A clean-lined Global guest chair for reception and waiting rooms, offered in a wide range of upholstery colours so it can be specified in an easy-clean fabric or vinyl to suit an infection-control policy.

An Offices to Go mesh-back synchro-tilter with an adjustable headrest — the all-day task chair for reception desks, dental administration, and clinician workstations where staff sit for the full shift.

settings.feat_body: Clinic seating has to be wiped down between patients, so favour non-porous upholstery — vinyl, polyurethane, or sealed polypropylene — over open-weave fabric in exam and treatment areas. If your infection-control policy calls for antimicrobial-treated upholstery, ask us and we will quote the options the lines we carry can be specified in.

Patient and waiting-room seating should be rated for the heaviest user, not the average. A 500 lb bariatric chair like the GC Comet, with flat armrests that take the weight of standing up, is safer and more comfortable for a wide range of patients than a standard guest chair.

settings.feat_title: Stackability and footprint for waiting rooms
settings.feat_body: Waiting rooms flex with the day's schedule. Stacking and compact chairs let staff add or clear seating fast and store the overflow against a wall — the GC Comet stacks two-high — so a small reception area can scale up at peak without permanent clutter.

Reception, administration, and clinical staff sit for the full shift, so their chairs need a real task mechanism — synchro-tilt, adjustable height, and back or headrest support — not the same seating you put a patient in for ten minutes. Match the chair to the hours it is worked.

settings.question: What is the best office chair for a medical or dental clinic?
settings.answer: There is no single best chair — a clinic needs seating matched to each room. For patient, exam, and waiting areas we point buyers to the Global Care GC Comet, a 500 lb bariatric stacking armchair that wipes clean and stores two-high; for general reception and waiting seating the Global Sidero guest chair, specified in an easy-clean upholstery; and for reception and clinician desks the Offices to Go Format synchro-tilter with an adjustable headrest. Brant Business Interiors carries all three and will match the right one to each space.

settings.question: Are your clinic chairs easy to clean and wipeable?
settings.answer: Yes — for exam and treatment areas we specify non-porous upholstery such as vinyl, polyurethane, or sealed polypropylene that staff can wipe down between patients, rather than open-weave fabric. We will not call a chair antimicrobial unless the manufacturer documents it; if your infection-control policy requires antimicrobial-treated surfaces, tell us and we will quote the upholstery options the lines we carry can be ordered in.

settings.question: Do you carry bariatric seating for patient and waiting rooms?
settings.answer: Yes. The Global Care GC Comet is a 500 lb bariatric stacking armchair designed for patient, exam, and waiting-room use, with wall-saver legs, a compact footprint, and flat armrests that assist entry and exit. Global's Global Care line also includes patient recliners and other clinical seating we can quote on request. Tell us the room and the capacity you need and we will spec it.

settings.question: What chairs work for medical and dental clinic staff?
settings.answer: Staff at reception, administration, and clinician desks sit for the full shift, so they need a proper task chair rather than patient seating. We carry the Offices to Go Format, a mesh-back synchro-tilter with an adjustable headrest and height adjustment for all-day support. For the wider range of staff task chairs see our ergonomic office chairs hub, and we will match the model to the desk and the hours.

settings.question: Can Ontario clinics and health units buy without a tender?
settings.answer: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — including public health units, hospitals, and clinics within them — can purchase from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Private clinics and dental practices simply order direct. Call us and we will confirm your eligibility and quote with delivery and installation across Ontario.
